about_the_game:
《Tracking Killer》 is a role-playing game set against the backdrop of modern crime investigation. In the game, you will play the role of a detective, conducting on-site investigations and investigations, sorting out the case, collecting evidence, and apprehending the murderer.

【Tips：E key - start/stop view control, Tab - squat/stand up】

Famous billionaire dies mysteriously

Early in the morning, I received a report of a homicide case, and the founder of a well-known local law firm, Su Hongwen, died suddenly. The cause of death is unknown.

Survey the site and search for clues

Highly simulating the criminal investigation process, focusing on the detailed investigation of the death scene of wealthy individuals by detectives, starting from environmental traces, personal belongings and other details, to uncover hidden clues.

Visit and investigate, identify the perpetrator

We will focus on conducting visits and investigations, starting from the relevant personnel who came into contact with the deceased before and after the time of death, to explore the interests and conflicts between individuals, and gradually identify the perpetrator.

Peel off the cocoon layer by layer, delving deeper and deeper

Through continuous investigation of evidence and testimony, layer by layer, the interests behind the deceased are constantly unlocked, the motive and method of the crime are discovered, and the perpetrator is identified.

Who is the murderer? Wait for you to uncover it

relatives? friend? cooperative partner? Private caregiver? workers? Many characters, who is the murderer? Waiting for you to decide and restore the truth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD Supported,SSD Recommended. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD Supported,SSD Recommended. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.
